excerpt: 8,249 candidate electron antineutrino events in 227.93 live days ... using a 10.3 cubic meter fiducial volume detector located at 1050 m from the reactor cores ... sin^2 2θ13 = 0.109 ± 0.030(stat) ± 0.025(syst). The data exclude the no-oscillation hypothesis at 99.8% CL (2.9σ).

title: Reactor electron antineutrino disappearance in the Double Chooz experiment
